title: Trump says he's cancelling Iran strikes, deal pending
description: Trump said that Iran and other Middle Eastern countries had asked the U.S. "to hold off any attack" on Iran because "the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to."

title: Bill championed by late Senator Lindsey Graham seeks to increase sanctions on Russia
description: A bipartisan bill to impose tough new sanctions on Russia is making progress in the U.S. Senate. But concerns over how the bill grants President Trump new tariff authorities is complicating the path.

title: U.S. general warns Pentagon he lacks sufficient forces to protect Israel
description: A shortage of Navy destroyers, used to defend against Iranian ballistic missile attacks, will force the head of U.S. European Command to prioritize the U.S. homeland instead, officials said.

title: The last day of a factory in Trump country, as its work moves to China
description: For generations, this Ohio factory was a way of life. Then came the final shift.

title: Tuesday referendum tests GOP push to restrict citizen-led ballot initiatives
description: In a referendum Tuesday, voters are being asked to raise the bar for ballot initiatives - a measure backed by Republicans after years of seeing voters allow abortion, expand Medicaid and allow gaming. Voters face similar measures in other states.

title: Week in Politics: Todd Blanche nomination; Michigan's Democratic Senate shakeup
description: Two nominations to watch: President Trump's of Todd Blanche to be U.S. Attorney General, and who Michigan Democrats will choose Tuesday to campaign for the U.S. Senate.

title: More than 25,000 children lose previous legal protections, as federal contract ends
description: Thousands of unaccompanied immigrant children are set to lose legal representation. The federal contract that pays for legal access expired Friday.

title: Staff Sgt. Rampersad, 28, who always knew she wanted to serve, is laid to rest
description: Staff Sgt. Angel S. Rampersad is one of a handful of service members who've recently died in the conflict with Iran. Her family says she knew from a young age she wanted to serve in the military.

title: In the race for Senate in Michigan, multiple party fights are colliding for Democrats
description: As Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed vie for the Democratic nomination, voters are debating which way the party should go: establishment or insurgent; progressive or more moderate; new media or old.

title: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
description: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.

title: Prosecutors move to dismiss Reflecting Pool vandalism case, saying 'botched installation' to blame
description: The government had accused David Hearn of ripping a piece of sealant after a $14-million renovation. Hearn has repeatedly said that he simply touched the water in the pool out of curiosity last month.

title: Trump says he ended their careers. Now these GOP lame ducks are defying him.
description: GOP Sens. John Cornyn (Texas) and Thom Tillis (North Carolina) are blocking Todd Blanche’s nomination to become attorney general.

title: The next abortion battle is over Kansas’s highest court
description: Voters will decide whether to replace a nearly 70-year-old appointment system with direct elections that could reshape the state Supreme Court for decades.

title: Trump announced a deal for Hamas to disarm. And, the U.S. economy slowed a bit
description: President Trump says a deal has been reached for Hamas to completely disarm and Israeli forces to withdraw from Gaza. And, the U.S. economy slowed some, but Americans continued to spend.
